export interface AccountCallControl {
    readonly assertCurrent: () => void;
    readonly signal?: AbortSignal;
    readonly beforeEffect?: () => Promise<void>;
    readonly initiatorProofRef?: string;
}

export interface AccountCredentialReference {
    readonly secretRef: string;
    readonly issuer: string;
    readonly environmentId: string;
    readonly applicationId: string;
    readonly clientId: string;
    readonly userId: string;
    readonly sessionId: string;
}

export interface AccountEnvelope {
    readonly requestId: string;
    readonly data: unknown;
}

export type AccountEnvironmentConfig = ClientEnvironmentConfig & {
    readonly applicationId: string;
};

export interface AccountOperationInput {
    readonly params?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
    readonly query?: Readonly<Record<string, string | number>>;
    readonly body?: unknown;
    readonly idempotencyKey?: string;
}

export type Scope = ({
    readonly kind: "PERSONAL";
}) | ({
    readonly kind: "TENANT";
    readonly tenantId: Id;
});
// exported from this entry as "AccountScope"

export interface AccountService {
    readSession(control: AccountCallControl): Promise<AccountView>;
    invoke(operationId: string, input: AccountOperationInput, control: AccountCallControl): Promise<AccountEnvelope>;
}

export type AccountView = ({
    readonly state: "ANONYMOUS" | "EXPIRED";
}) | ({
    readonly state: "AUTHENTICATED";
    readonly user: UserView;
    readonly session: SessionView;
    readonly capabilities: ReadonlyArray<PlatformCapability>;
}) | ({
    readonly state: "OFFLINE_CACHED";
    readonly user: UserView;
});

    readonly assignmentId: Id;
    readonly subscriptionId: Id;
    readonly seatTypeId: Id;
    readonly membershipId: Id;
    readonly userId: Id;
    readonly assignedAt: Timestamp;
    readonly version: Version;
    readonly status: "ASSIGNED";
    readonly endedAt: null;
    readonly endReason: null;
}) | ({
    readonly assignmentId: Id;
    readonly subscriptionId: Id;
    readonly seatTypeId: Id;
    readonly membershipId: Id;
    readonly userId: Id;
    readonly assignedAt: Timestamp;
    readonly version: Version;
    readonly status: "ENDED";
    readonly endedAt: Timestamp;
    readonly endReason: "RELEASED" | "REASSIGNED" | "MEMBER_LEFT" | "MEMBER_REMOVED";
});

export type AuditEvent = {
    readonly auditEventId: Id;
    readonly actorUserId: Id;
    readonly operation: Id;
    readonly target: {
        readonly kind: Id;
        readonly id: Id;
    };
    readonly tenantId: (Id) | (null);
    readonly occurredAt: Timestamp;
    readonly result: "SUCCEEDED" | "DENIED";
    readonly changes: ReadonlyArray<{
        readonly field: Id;
        readonly before: (string) | (null);
        readonly after: (string) | (null);
    }>;
};

export type EntitlementCheckResult = {
    readonly scope: Scope;
    readonly evaluatedAt: Timestamp;
    readonly revision: Id;
    readonly decisions: ReadonlyArray<EntitlementDecision>;
};

export type EntitlementDecision = ({
    readonly featureId: Id;
    readonly allowed: true;
    readonly reason: "GRANTED";
    readonly validUntil: Timestamp;
    readonly sources: ReadonlyArray<EntitlementSource>;
}) | ({
    readonly featureId: Id;
    readonly allowed: false;
    readonly reason: "FEATURE_NOT_GRANTED";
    readonly validUntil: Timestamp;
    readonly sources: ReadonlyArray<EntitlementSource>;
});

export type EntitlementSource = ({
    readonly kind: "PERSONAL_SUBSCRIPTION";
    readonly subscriptionId: Id;
}) | ({
    readonly kind: "TENANT_SEAT";
    readonly subscriptionId: Id;
    readonly seatTypeId: Id;
    readonly assignmentId: Id;
});

export type Feature = {
    readonly featureId: Id;
    readonly product: "WORK" | "CLUB" | "SHARED";

};

type ClientEnvironmentConfig = ({
    readonly environmentId: Id;
    readonly authOrigin: string;
    readonly productOrigin: string;
    readonly clientId: Id;
    readonly policyProfile: "unified-account-v2";
    readonly redirectAllowlist: ReadonlyArray<HttpUrl>;
    readonly environmentKind: "LOCAL" | "TEST";
    readonly deliveryMode: "MOCK" | "LIVE";
    readonly providerMode: "MOCK" | "LIVE";
}) | ({
    readonly environmentId: Id;
    readonly authOrigin: string;
    readonly productOrigin: string;
    readonly clientId: Id;
    readonly policyProfile: "unified-account-v2";
    readonly redirectAllowlist: ReadonlyArray<HttpUrl>;
    readonly environmentKind: "PRODUCTION";
    readonly deliveryMode: "LIVE";
    readonly providerMode: "LIVE";
});

type DisplayName = string;

type Email = string;

type HttpUrl = string;

type Id = string;

type LoginMethod = {
    readonly bindingId: Id;
    readonly type: LoginMethodType;
    readonly maskedLabel: string;
    readonly verified: boolean;
    readonly usableForLogin: boolean;
};

type LoginMethodType = "EMAIL" | "PHONE" | "GOOGLE" | "GITHUB";

type PlanVersionNumber = number;

type PlatformCapability = "TENANT_CREATE" | "TENANT_READ" | "TENANT_STATUS" | "CATALOG_WRITE" | "SUBSCRIPTION_READ" | "SUBSCRIPTION_WRITE" | "AUDIT_READ" | "APPLICATION_READ" | "APPLICATION_WRITE" | "CLIENT_READ" | "CLIENT_WRITE" | "USER_READ" | "USER_STATUS" | "USER_EMAIL_WRITE" | "PLATFORM_PERMISSION_WRITE";

type PngDataUrl = string;

type SeatType = {
    readonly seatTypeId: Id;
    readonly name: DisplayName;
    readonly featureIds: ReadonlyArray<Id>;
};

type SubscriptionOwner = {
    readonly kind: "USER" | "TENANT";
    readonly id: Id;
};

type TenantRole = "OWNER" | "ADMIN" | "MEMBER";

type Timestamp = string;

type Version = number;
